verdict.rationale: Working Copy has automation surfaces (Shortcuts, x-callback-url, WebDAV) and a built-in Repository Agent, so issuing scoped credentials to an agent is a fair question for this product. The evidence never shows the product issuing scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent. Secure Enclave SSH keys and the AWS IAM policy setup are user identity and host-provider arrangements, not agent-scoped credentials the product issues.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
